text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Mejiro Ardan at the 
sundries section in the school store.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Playing cards, Reversi... Ohajiki? 
Isn't there something that would get 
people more hyped...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh? My apologies. I spoke up without 
thinking...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Um... I apologize for the sudden question, 
but do you happen to know of any fun games 
we can play indoors?
choice_data_list: Is it limited to indoor games?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, um... The truth is, my body is rather 
frail, so everyone seems to hesitate to 
invite me out...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'd like to invite you to do 
something casual where you don't have to 
hold back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
However... I am not well versed in modern 
trends... What sort of pastime would be 
suitable...?
choice_data_list: Maybe upload an aesthetic video to UmaTok?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Karuta, is it...? How nostalgic. I used to 
play Hyakunin Isshu quite often in the 
past.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Still, will they really enjoy it? It isn't 
exactly a cutting-edge game or anything...

Noticing a rather unique set of karuta 
cards on the shelf, I decided to recommend 
them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what's that? "Super Heated☆Umamusume 
Karuta"...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Covering everyone from legendary 
Umamusume of the past to active racers"? 
My, to think such merchandise exists...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, 'O', 'O', 'O' is... 'Oguri Cap, 
the Ash-Haired Cinderella of Kasamatsu.'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Giggle... Ahaha...! Well now, could my 
card be among them as well?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Looks like she'll enjoy this...! Thank you 
for letting me know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
To make up for all the times I couldn't 
have fun before, I hope I can make lots of 
memories with everyone now...

Whispering those words, a faint smile 
gently softened her face—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
UmaTok... is it? I've only ever heard the 
name mentioned by my classmates...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Um, if it's not too much trouble, could 
you teach me how to take good photos...?
"Zukyun♪ Bakyun♪ Zuzuzuzukyu~~~~n♪"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: S-Struck by Cupid's arrow♪, that's what!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Is it something like this...? It's a 
little embarrassing.
choice_data_list: I'm going to edit it, so just wait.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Ufufu! Well, my goodness. What a 
delightful game they have these days.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
With this, everyone can have fun together 
even inside our room...!

She flashed a bright smile, as if 
completely unable to contain her 
excitement.
